mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'GLOBAL' THEN 1 END) as global_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'BOT' THEN 1 END) as bot_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'CONVERSATION' THEN 1 END) as conversation_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'SESSION' THEN 1 END) as session_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN scope = 'MESSAGE' THEN 1 END) as message_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'STRING' THEN 1 END) as string_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'NUMBER' THEN 1 END) as number_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'BOOLEAN' THEN 1 END) as boolean_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'OBJECT' THEN 1 END) as object_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'ARRAY' THEN 1 END) as array_count FROM conversation_variables WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false
